summary: Well presented 3 bedroom mid terrace property offered to investors only, benefiting from a sitting tenant and providing an immediate rental income.
description:
ENTRANCE HALL Welcoming entrance hallway with laminate flooring, providing access to the lounge and dining room. The hallway offers a bright and practical entrance to the property.

LOUNGE Well proportioned lounge featuring a double glazed window overlooking the front of the property, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the room and creating a bright and comfortable living space.

DINING ROOM Spacious dining room with french doors opening onto the rear garden, providing plenty of natural light and an ideal space for family dining and entertaining. The room also offers direct access to the kitchen.

KITCHEN Modern fitted kitchen comprising a range of white high gloss wall and base units complemented by black splashback tiling. There is plumbing for a washing machine, space for a freestanding oven, and ample worktop space. The kitchen also offers room for a small breakfast bar area, creating a practical and versatile space for everyday living.

BEDROOM Spacious master bedroom offering ample room for freestanding furniture, creating a comfortable and versatile space. The room benefits from plenty of natural light from two double glazed windows over-looking the front of the property.

BEDROOM Good sized double bedroom situated to the rear of the property, offering a bright and comfortable living space with ample room for freestanding furniture.

BEDROOM Single bedroom located to the front of the property, ideal as a child's room, home office, or guest bedroom, with space for essential furniture.

BATHROOM Family bathroom fitted with a panelled bath with handheld shower attachment, wash hand basin, and low level WC. The room benefits from a double glazed frosted window, providing natural light while maintaining privacy.

EXTERNALLY To the rear, the property benefits from an enclosed garden featuring a decking area, ideal for outdoor seating and entertaining, together with a useful storage outhouse. Situated in a quiet cul-de-sac location, the property also benefits from convenient on street parking.
